tenderSchedule.title: SERVICE PROFESSIONALS FOR KREDL FY 2026-27
tenderSchedule.description: HIRING OF SERVICE PROFESSIONALS FOR KREDL

tenderAddress.blockNumber: KREDL. Head Office #6/13/1, 10th Block, Marilingappa Extension, Nagarbhavi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560072

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The agency should have provided earlier, similar services to Govt. Departments, PSUs, Reputed Commercial Organizations by deploying at least 100 Highly skilled, Semiskilled, Unskilled, personnel having business units at more than one location in the state continuously for one year, out of the last two preceding financial years and should have rendered service satisfactorily. Documentary proof along with certificate of satisfactory service issued by the previous employers should be uploaded. KREDL will verify the documents with the concerned wherever necessary. However documents like Service agreements, Work Orders/any other documents with incomplete details, will not be considered for the purpose.

The annual turnover of the Agency should not be less than 3.00 Crore in any one of the last 3 financial years (i.e. for the year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25). The agency should submit proof in this regard by way of Annual Statement of Accounts i.e. Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss A/c, (includes Income & Expenditure, Receipts and Payment Account instead of P&L A/c for Non-profit making organization), audited and certified by a Chartered Accountant (The documents like self-certification of turnover, certification of CA in any other mode other than P&L A/c and Balance Sheet, income statement prepared for filing IT etc. will not be considered).
